descFull: An open-source ADE that works like a messaging app: chat with Codex, Claude Code, DeepSeek and other agent CLIs on your computer, from desktop or phone. Built for developers and everyday people. Resume CLI sessions on your phone. 12 chats side by side. Multi-Bot groups and workflows. Bots message each other. Computers join one private network.
